battle.name: 安西之戰
battle.theater: 雙河（今吉爾吉斯楚河上游）
battle.brief: 長久二年（692），西突厥可汗阿史那咄支反唐，進逼安西四鎮；唐遣王孝傑為安西行軍大總管，率諸道兵出安西，於楚河上游雙河一帶大破突厥，擒其可汗，遂復置龜茲、疏勒、于闐、焉耆四鎮。秦弩仍在役：守城時壓住攻城之敵，出師後以弩配橫刀長槊，補步卒面對輕騎的射擊壓力。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 武周一方以女皇武則天為最高決策者，執行機構是尚書省兵部與行軍大總管府：前線由安西都護府坐鎮龜茲，與昆陵、濛池二都護府分治天山南北，安西四鎮——龜茲、疏勒、于闐、焉耆——是唐軍在西域的骨幹據點，另有河西沿邊州縣提供兵源與糧餉。兵員來自關中府兵、河西與隴右的州兵，以及龜茲、于闐、疏勒等城國提供的蕃兵與馬匹，軍隊以步兵為主、騎兵為輔，橫刀長槊的近戰骨幹加上弩弓的射擊骨幹。西突厥汗國以阿史那氏為統系，汗庭在碎葉以西，控制塔里木盆地北緣與天山北麓的遊牧地，帳帳部眾以弓馬為業，號令隨可汗遷徙。西域諸城國多在兩強之間周旋，既受西突厥徵發，也向唐廷朝貢。安西之戰正是這兩套體系在雙河一線的正面碰撞。
countriesEn: The Tang side under Empress Wu Zetian was run from the top by the throne itself, with the Ministry of War and the office of the Grand Commander on Expedition handling the field command. In the front line the Anxi Protectorate sat at Kucha, working together with the Kunling and Mengchi protectorates that governed the north and south of the Tian Shan; the four Anxi garrisons - Kucha, Kashgar, Khotan and Karashahr - were the skeleton of Tang power in the Western Regions, while the prefectures and counties of Hexi supplied troops and grain. Fighters came from the Guanzhong fubing militia, the provincial troops of Hexi and Longyou, and the native contingents and mounts provided by city-states such as Kucha, Khotan and Kashgar. The army was infantry-led with cavalry attached: tang dao sabres and long spears for close work, crossbows and bows for shooting. The Western Turkic Khaganate was ruled by the Ashina clan from a khagan encampment west of Suyab, covering the northern rim of the Tarim Basin and the pastures of the Tian Shan's northern slopes, where every encampment lived by bow and horse and orders moved with the khagan's migrations. The city-states of the Western Regions steered between the two powers, answering Turkic levy calls while also paying tribute to the Tang court. The Battle of Anxi was the head-on collision of these two systems on the line of the Twin Rivers.
people: 武則天是這場戰爭的真正決策者：她以詔書任命安西行軍大總管、下令諸道兵馬西出玉門，並在戰後決定如何處置被擒的可汗，是「恩威並施、以撫為主」這條邊疆路線的制定者。主帥王孝傑出身軍門，久任邊鎮，692年以安西行軍大總管統兵出塞，是全役唯一主將；他在雙河擊潰突厥主力、擒其可汗，因功進封郡王，其後奉命赴突厥說降默啜而稱疾不行，一度被貶出外，數年後方得復用。西突厥可汗阿史那咄支是此戰另一端的主角：他早年受唐冊封，垂拱年間起兵反唐、攻陷安西四鎮，692年兵敗雙河被俘，押送洛陽後獲赦並授官。默啜可汗——咄支的兄弟——正是在這段亂局中奪取汗位，日後成為唐在西域最難纏的對手。《舊唐書》另載段志玄預此役，因行軍後期不至而一度被貶，旋即復官，軍中對賞罰與指揮的爭議由此可見。
peopleEn: Empress Wu was the real decision maker in this war: by edict she appointed the Anxi grand commander, ordered the troops of the circuits westward past Yumen Pass, and afterwards decided what to do with the captured khagan, setting the tone of a frontier policy that mixed coercion with conciliation. Wang Xiaojie, the commander, came from a military family and had long served on the borders; in 692 he took the field as Anxi xingjun da zongguan and was the single field leader of the whole operation. He broke the main Turkic force at the Twin Rivers, captured the khagan and was raised to a princedom for the victory; later he was sent to the Turks to persuade Mohe Chuo to surrender, claimed illness instead of going, and was demoted before being restored to office some years afterwards. Ashina Duzhi, the Western Turkic khagan, was the other principal figure: once invested by the Tang, he rose in revolt during the Chuigong years, overran the four Anxi garrisons, and in 692 was defeated at the Twin Rivers and taken prisoner, after which he was escorted to Luoyang, pardoned and given office. Mohe Chuo, Duzhi's brother, seized the khanship amid this same turmoil and would become the Tang court's most persistent opponent in the Western Regions. The Old Book of Tang records that Duan Zhixuan also served in this campaign and was demoted for failing to arrive with the rear of the column before being restored, which shows the argument over discipline and command inside the army.
kits: 這場戰役的裝備主軸是弩。秦弩自戰國以來定形，漢代成為邊軍標配，唐承其制：弩機把拉力先存起來，射手不必像拉弓那樣全程用力，射速遠勝於弓，這就是「弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓」的技術底子。692年戰役裡，弩有兩個位置。一是守城：四鎮皆為夯土版築的方形城，龜茲、疏勒、于闐、焉耆四城牆頭密布蹶張弩、擘張弩與床弩，攻城者一旦貼近牆根就成排被射倒，正是「守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外」。二是出師：唐軍自玉門關、伊州與庭州一線西行，弩手配發射的橫刀、長槊與拒馬、羓藜，與騎兵合編，掩護行軍縱隊與糧隊。遠征裝備還包括駱駝隊運載的糧秣、幕車與帳幕、驛馬傳遞軍報，以及四鎮與河西州縣儲備的麥、粟、鹽、茶。突厥一方則是複合角弓、短馬刀、長矛、皮甲與少量鐵甲，騎射是本行，攻城器械闕如，攻四鎮主要靠圍城與輕騎衝撞。
kitsEn: The equipment spine of this battle was the crossbow. The Chinese crossbow took its settled shape in the Warring States, became standard issue for frontier troops under the Han, and the Tang carried the pattern forward: the lock stores the draw force first, so the shooter does not have to hold full tension the way a bowman must, and the rate of fire is far better than with a bow. That is the technical core of the line about the lock storing the pull and outranging a bow in rate of fire. In 692 the crossbow held two positions. First, in defence: all four garrisons were square rammed-earth cities several li a side, and the walls of Kucha, Kashgar, Khotan and Karashahr were lined with tread-drawn crossbows, shoulder crossbows and bed crossbows, so that men who reached the wall were shot down in rows - the very effect of a defending side using the crossbow to keep attackers pinned outside the wall. Second, on the march: the Tang army moved west from Yumen Pass and the Yizhou and Tingzhou line, with crossbowmen carrying the tang dao, the long spear, the cheval-de-frise and the caltrop, and were combined with cavalry to cover the marching column and the baggage train. The expedition's equipment included camel trains carrying grain, tent carts and camp furniture, relay horses for despatches, and the wheat, millet, salt and tea stored at the four garrisons and the Hexi prefectures. The Turks, by contrast, had composite horn bows, short sabres, long spears, leather armour with a little iron plate, and made their skill riding and shooting; they had almost no siege engine, and their attack on the four garrisons relied on blockade and light cavalry charges.
tactics: 唐軍的戰法是「集結—會師—決戰—追擊」四段。集結期，諸道兵馬自河西走廊出玉門關，經伊州、庭州一線北上碎葉，在天山南北兩麓合勢，再西指雙河；會師後由安西行軍大總管府統一節制，前軍據山口、步軍結陣、騎兵掩兩翼。決戰的基本陣形是弩手居後列蹲射、長槊手居前列拒馬，弩手分批輪射，輪射之間由長槊陣與騎兵遮蔽，形成不間斷的箭幕；這是唐軍面對突厥輕騎的主要手段，弩弓的射界覆蓋住騎兵衝鋒必須穿越的距離。突厥的戰法是純粹的機動與射擊：散騎游弋，試探唐陣兩翼的缺口，再以數百騎為一群銜枚疾馳突入，企圖以速度撕開步軍；不能得手便立刻拉出射程重整，再以萬箭齊射掩護退卻。攻防之轉換發生在雙河：唐軍在楚河上游背水列陣，弩箭壓住騎兵展開衝鋒的空間，突厥無法完成衝鋒，最終在唐軍的縱深追擊下潰散。唐軍雖勝，卻因深入草場、糧道拉長，攻勢止於雙河一帶，未能追窮潰逃之眾。
tacticsEn: The Tang method ran in four stages: concentration, junction, decision and pursuit. During concentration the troops of the circuits left Yumen Pass along the Hexi corridor, moved north through the Yizhou and Tingzhou line to Suyab, joined up on both flanks of the Tian Shan and then turned west for the Twin Rivers. Once united, the command of the Anxi grand commander held the army together: the vanguard held the passes, the infantry closed ranks and cavalry covered the two flanks. The line of decision rested on a standard array, with crossbowmen kneeling in the rear, spearmen in front behind the chevaux-de-frise, the crossbowmen firing by turns, and the spear wall and the cavalry screening them between volleys so as to produce an unbroken sheet of arrows. That was the Tang answer to Turkic light horse, since the range of the crossbows covered the distance a mounted charge had to cross. The Turkic method was pure manoeuvre and shooting: outriders scattered wide, tested the flanks of the Tang array for gaps, and then a few hundred riders with bits muffled would charge at speed into an opening, trying to tear the infantry apart; when that failed they pulled out of range, reformed, and covered the withdrawal with a mass of arrows. The turn of the battle came at the Twin Rivers, where the Tang army deployed with the river behind it, crossbow fire denying the horsemen the space to build up a charge, so the Turks could not get their charge home and finally broke up under the Tang pursuit. The Tang won, but they had pushed deep into the pastures with a stretched supply line, and their offensive stopped near the Twin Rivers without running the broken enemy to ground.
data: 可考的基本數字有限。年份是692年，即武周長久二年，距唐滅阿史那賀魯、平定西突厥的657年約三十五年，距四鎮失守的686年約六年。戰場雙河位於今吉爾吉斯斯坦楚河上游，自古是草原孔道；自安西都護府治所龜茲直線到雙河，按今地圖約六百餘公里，若繞行碎葉方向，行軍距離更遠，糧秣全賴駱駝、牛與馬分批輸送。時間上，出師集結到決戰約一兩個月，擒獲可汗後自西域押送洛陽，數千里驛程需數十日。兵力方面，史籍只以「諸道兵」概稱，未載確數，雙方會集之眾當在數萬之譜；唐軍斬獲亦以「破」「擒」計，數以萬計，說明這是一場雙方投入相當兵力的會戰，而非小股遭遇。守城一側，四鎮皆為數里見方的州級城，弩手配置與城牆長度相稱，攻城方沒有足以攻破的器械，最後靠的是反攻。
dataEn: The recoverable numbers are few. The year is 692, the second year of the Changjiu era under Wu Zhou, roughly thirty-five years after the Tang destroyed Ashina Helu and subdued the Western Turks in 657, and about six years after the loss of the four garrisons in 686. The battlefield, the Twin Rivers, lay on the upper Chu in present-day Kyrgyzstan, a grassland corridor that had always been a route. The straight-line distance from the seat of the Anxi Protectorate at Kucha to the Twin Rivers is a little over six hundred kilometres on a modern map, and the marching distance was longer again if the column swung around via Suyab, with grain carried by camels, oxen and horses in batches. In time, the interval between mustering and the decisive battle was about a month or two, and the escort of the captured khagan from the Western Regions to Luoyang, several thousand li of post road, needed some tens of days. On strength, the histories say only 'the troops of the circuits' and give no firm figure; the forces gathered on both sides must have run into the tens of thousands, and the Tang's losses and captures are given as 'broken' and 'seized', counted by the ten thousand, which marks this as a battle of substantial forces on both sides rather than a small collision. On the defensive side, all four garrisons were prefectural cities several li square, the number of crossbowmen matched the length of the walls, and the attackers had no engine that could break through them; what finally decided it was the counterstroke.
cause: 戰爭有兩層起因。第一層是眼前的衝突：垂拱年間（685至686年），西突厥可汗阿史那咄支起兵反唐，攻陷西域的安西四鎮，唐廷被迫罷四鎮、退守，雙方關係由冊封與朝貢轉為兵戎相見；692年，咄支再度進兵安西、拒絕撤軍，唐廷不能再容忍西域名城與絲路要道淪為遊牧勢力的前哨。第二層是結構性的：唐在西域的據點網與西突厥的遊牧經濟本來就互相排斥——四鎮是農業城，是糧、帛與馬匹的來源，汗國需要這些城國的供給；692年前後西突厥內部的汗位之爭又給了唐介入的縫隙，唐廷得以用「冊封叛者、恢復舊制」的名義把出兵說成處置叛亂，而不是赤裸的疆土擴張。同期唐廷還必須分兵防備吐蕃在青海與西域的牽制，安西是河西的前線，守住安西就是守住河西的糧源與通道。
causeEn: The war had two layers of cause. The immediate one was the collision itself: during the Chuigong years, from 685 to 686, the Western Turkic khagan Ashina Duzhi rose in revolt, overran the Anxi garrisons in the Western Regions, and the Tang court was forced to abolish the four garrisons and fall back, so that relations turned from investiture and tribute into armed conflict. In 692 Duzhi advanced on Anxi again and refused to withdraw, and the court could no longer tolerate the major cities of the Western Regions and the artery of the silk road becoming an outpost of the nomadic power. The deeper cause was structural: the Tang network of strongholds in the West and the nomadic economy of the Western Turks excluded each other by nature, since the four garrisons were agricultural cities and the source of grain, cloth and horses, and the khaganate needed exactly what those cities held. The struggle over the khanship inside the Western Turks around 692 gave the Tang a seam to work with, so the court could present the expedition as punishing a rebellion and restoring an old order under the banner of investiture rather than as naked territorial expansion. At the same time the Tang had to split forces to watch the Tibetan pressure in Qinghai and the Western Regions: Anxi was the forward position of Hexi, and holding Anxi meant holding Hexi's grain supply and its routes.
impact: 此役之後，安西四鎮復置，唐朝的西域經營重新有了骨架，龜茲、疏勒、于闐、焉耆回到唐的藩屏體系，絲路南道與天山南北的往來恢復正常，敦煌、涼州與長安之間的驛傳和商隊重新得到護衛。俘獲阿史那咄支並把他送回洛陽、赦免授官，是一次成功的政治示範：唐廷用懷柔換取部眾的歸附與商路上的安寧，同時向草原諸部表明唐有實力跨境用兵。戰術層面則證明弩在唐代邊防中的分量——四鎮城頭的弩手能把輕騎攻城者壓在牆外，這正是秦弩這張卡片的核心敘述：弩機儲力、射速勝弓，防守方用它贏下攻防的交換比。長期看，唐在中亞方向的存在感延伸到楚河上游，到751年怛羅斯之役時，唐的影響力已能伸抵中亞腹地；同時，草原權力並未因一敗而崩潰，默啜可汗崛起後，唐西疆此後半個多世紀始終在戰與和之間擺盪。
impactEn: After the campaign the four Anxi garrisons were restored and the Tang's Western Regions policy regained a skeleton. Kucha, Kashgar, Khotan and Karashahr returned to the Tang's screen of vassal city-states, traffic on the southern silk road and around the Tian Shan recovered, and the post stations and caravans between Dunhuang, Liangzhou and Chang'an once more had protection. Taking Ashina Duzhi alive and bringing him back to Luoyang, where he was pardoned and given office, was a successful political demonstration: the court bought the submission of the tribes and the safety of the trade routes with conciliation, while showing the steppe that the Tang could project force across the frontier. Tactically the campaign also demonstrated what the crossbow was worth in Tang frontier defence, for the crossbowmen on the walls of the four garrisons pinned the mounted attackers outside the wall - which is exactly the core claim of the Qin crossbow card: the lock stores the draw, the rate of fire beats the bow, and the defending side wins the exchange of fire with it. In the long run Tang presence in Central Asia reached the upper Chu, and by the time of Talas in 751 the influence of the Tang already extended into the heartland of Central Asia. At the same time the steppe power did not collapse from a single defeat, and after Mohe Chuo took the khanship the Tang western frontier spent the next half century swinging between war and peace.
result: 唐軍在雙河取得了明確的戰術勝利：西突厥主力被擊潰，可汗阿史那咄支被擒獲送京，部眾或降或散，西域的門戶重新打開，唐廷隨即復置安西四鎮、重派守將與戍兵，並把這場勝利寫進對北方與西域的昭示，宣布四鎮已復。但勝利也是有限的：唐軍深入草原之後糧道拉長，攻勢止於雙河一帶，沒有一鼓作氣蕩平汗國；西突厥的部族聯盟沒有被摧毀，汗位仍由突騎施與突利系貴族掌控，692年被擒的只是一位可汗，而不是一個政權。政治上，武周以赦免和授官安撫了被俘可汗，換來短期安寧，卻未能解決汗國內部的權力競爭；默啜可汗很快坐穩汗位，並在數年之後把矛頭完全轉向唐的邊境。安西之戰最終留下的格局是：唐守住並修復了西域的城池與通道，把邊防重心壓回城防與據點，弩手與城牆重新成為天山南北防線的基本樣式；草原帝國依然強盛，而唐在西域的存在從此長期維持在「進可出師、退可固守」的狀態。
resultEn: The Tang won a clear tactical victory at the Twin Rivers: the main Western Turkic force was broken, the khagan Ashina Duzhi was taken alive and sent to the capital, tribes surrendered or scattered, the door into the Western Regions opened again, and the court promptly restored the four Anxi garrisons, sent back their commanders and garrison troops, and wrote the victory into its proclamations to the north and west, announcing that the four garrisons were recovered. But the victory was limited. With the army deep in the pastures and the supply line stretched, the offensive stopped around the Twin Rivers; there was no drive to flatten the khaganate in one stroke, and the tribal confederation of the Western Turks was not destroyed. The khanship stayed in the hands of the Turgesh and Tuli lines of nobles: in 692 a single khagan was captured, not a state. Politically the Wu Zhou court pardoned the captive khagan and gave him office to buy a short spell of quiet, but that did not settle the struggle over authority inside the khaganate; Mohe Chuo soon took the khanship firmly and turned his spear entirely against the Tang border. The result the Battle of Anxi left behind was this: the Tang repaired the cities and routes of the Western Regions and pushed the weight of its frontier back onto fortification and garrison, with crossbowmen and walls once again the basic pattern of the defence line north and south of the Tian Shan; the steppe empire remained strong, and the Tang presence in the West stayed in the state of able to march out, able to hold ground.
